meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Thanks for making time, I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't told me one thing you have on Owen's essay. What else do you have besides the checker?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
"Most parents would take it." I'm not most parents, Hale, and I'm not signing for something nobody has shown me. On what basis was the zero entered?
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until you show me what the zero rests on, and not before it's withdrawn. Otherwise I'm going upstairs to the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal's review; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under 4.4, and it was not reached because she never heard any evidence, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because the rewrite offer matched what 4.4 allows but came with no document behind it.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before showing any evidence, then pressing her with the idea that other parents would accept it, which made the offer sound like a way to close the matter instead of a finding.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night because none was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and whether Owen was spoken to, answer that plainly, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then put one dated document in front of her.
